in_sanskrit.name: गणेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who leads the group of deities, the one who is the god of wisdom, knowledge, new beginnings, and the remover of obstacles.

in_tamil.name: கணேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who holds the axe, the one who removes obstacles

in_marathi.name: Mursalim
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mursalim हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Muru' meaning moon and 'Salim' meaning protector. The name Mursalim signifies a person who protects and nurtures like the moon in the night sky.
